crew-reviewer.description: Reviews one branch per dispatch, before that branch merges and before any squash, and (feature mode) the whole feature diff once at the first drain; reports CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW findings with snippet-anchored citations. Findings are advisory — no branch is blocked or re-queued.

crew-triage.description: Classifies a crew-afk branch's verification failure as fixable by more code on that branch, or as an environment/infrastructure problem no code change can fix. Dispatched only after verify-worktree.sh has already failed, and only before a coder would otherwise be redispatched for another full attempt. Independent of the coder that wrote the branch — the same reason review is a separate dispatch, not a self-grade.

crew-coder.description: Implements a single issue using TDD, verifies checks, commits.

crew-afk.description: Orchestrator that spawns parallel crew-coder agents in isolated worktrees, merges completed branches, runs a crew-reviewer pass, promotes every Actionable review finding into a second fix phase, and loops until all ready-for-agent issues are done.

tdd.description: Test-driven development with red-green-refactor loop, vertical slices.

dep-install.description: Detect install mode (host or docker) and install project dependencies once. Shared by solve-issue, crew-address-findings, and address-pr-comments.

solve-issue.description: Implement a single issue end-to-end: read, explore, install, TDD, verify, commit.

crew-address-findings.description: Triage and fix findings from a crew-afk code review report using TDD.

address-pr-comments.description: Fetch PR review comments, challenge each critically, implement sensible ones with TDD, commit and push.

to-issues.description: Break a plan or PRD into independently-grabbable issues using tracer-bullet vertical slices.

to-prd.description: Synthesize conversation context into a PRD and publish to the issue tracker.

crew-brainstorm.description: Collaborative design pipeline: explore intent, propose approaches, build a spec, then hand off to PRD and issues.

crew-grill.description: Adversarial design pipeline: stress-test every assumption, capture decisions, then produce a PRD and issues.

add-tests.description: Discover the project's coverage command, rank under-covered files by risk, resolve a mocking convention per ecosystem, and hand findings to to-issues as ready-for-agent issues.

upgrade-deps.description: Audit outdated npm/yarn/pnpm dependencies for exploitability, transitive conflicts, and usage, then publish issues (batched safe bumps, one per risky package or coupled group) with a safety checklist.

configure-tracker.description: Select and install an issue tracker template. Presents a numbered menu of templates from docs/templates/trackers/, then writes the chosen template to the project-level config path.

domain-modeling.description: Updates CONTEXT.md glossary and creates ADRs inline as design decisions crystallise.

write-pr.description: Write a PR body for a human reviewer: Summary (smallest diagram or diff-sketch), Evidence (before/after), Merge Danger (door, blast radius).
